name: ANSI/IEEE connector socket half symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for connector socket half, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The jack-side connector form identifies the mating interface for a separately referenced plug. Terminal naming and pin-view information prevent accidental reversal when translating between a front view and a wiring view.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the socket's pin orientation from its documented view.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A socket-half schematic form does not describe mechanical shell dimensions or keying.
